product_flow.name: Dolls' carriages, wheeled toys designed to be ridden by children

required_qualifiers: actual manufacturer and model
serial and first-release cohort
child-toy purpose and direct front-wheel pedal drive
frame substrate grade and welded geometry
actual coating and supplied frame completeness
fork and handlebar module version
seat rubber specification and fitting
solid tyre and hub specification
steel crank and non-slip pedal configuration
wheel bearing and head-tube bush identities by version
grips and steering-stop configuration
axle fasteners and actual component supply overlaps
all integral delivered accessories
calibrated net whole-toy weighing and tare
configuration-specific acceptance plan and results
actual rework permission and postwork disposition
site geography and production period
utility state and upstream supplier coverage
opening and closing raw WIP and unassigned-store vectors
released FG and original-cohort service horizon
gross dispatch returns and original-dispatch reversal
each packaging pool and supplier-included ownership
allocation evidence and unresolved actual quantities

full_context_review.scope: Complete actual H2 5 and9 prose and source-unit spans; no fixed section5 paragraph minimum or language-length heuristic. Cross-section applicability/meaning is independently reviewed separately.

actual_stored_projection_bodies.scope: All12 protocol fields, complete calculation/input/output, quality requirements/evidence, all measurement/property/unit bodies, source records, full row descriptions/amount evidence/basis/ranges, boundary/allocation/validation and reference fields. Literal and complete source/ancestor context checks are separate.

measurementRules.rule: The reference is 1 kg complete first-released net toy mass; measure each actual configuration on a suitable calibrated scale with real tare, included parts and acceptance record using cp_release. Sum measured accepted net masses to Q; no assumed item-to-kg factor.

Preserve each actual row numerator unit: kg for mass, MJ for electrical energy and t*km for transport. Integrate only actual rates; convert raw units and physical state first from independent measurements. Total integrated volume is not multiplied by duration again. No universal Mass/kg constraint applies to all rows.

Collection records unnormalized raw data only. Determine a numerator and its actual cohort denominator before the unique single_quotient operation in §8. Cards and protocol aggregation retrieve the same saved normalized_exchange; neither divides again. Zero/missing denominator preserves actual loads/stocks and yields no unit result.

calculationRules.rule: Convert original raw totals to their actual native extensive unit before allocation. Integrate a true rate over its measured intervals once; keep already integrated amounts intact. Mass from volume requires independently measured substance-specific density and state. Electricity kWh to MJ uses exact factor3.6; transport uses real gross payload and distance with declared empty-return convention.

For each exchange j: U_j = U_direct_j + B_open_store_j + R_store_j - B_close_store_j. U_direct is directly consumed nonstored expenditure or an already consumption-net record; R_store includes only receipts into the disjoint unused/unassigned non-WIP store. No receipt or vector can be in both U_direct and R_store. Apply the store correction once only to that store partition, excluding WIP, FG, packaging and separately assigned asset service. Do not correct an already consumption-net record again. A_j = opening WIP vector_j + U_j - closing WIP vector_j - legitimate T_other_j. T_other exists only for genuinely other cohort/function with justified transfer once, never ordinary waste/scrap sale alone. Closing FG is absent from the subtraction. Physical gross receipts remain full in their separate reconciliation view.

calculationRules.applies_to: original-cohort service and asset burden dimensions
calculationRules.rule: Determine actual performed service and evidenced asset-use burden by original cohort c and horizon H with the original Qc. Preserve historical vectors and D_rev from the actual original dispatch without assuming equal current return mass. Add true incremental replacement/repair/testing/treatment burdens once. Carry forward only evidenced unused/unassigned service or charge; no subtraction for performed service merely retained in closing FG.

Select numerator V as the complete actual physical event leg in its actual extensive unit. Keep V unscaled by economic shares, burden allocation or stock-vector subtraction. Pair its independent upstream/service burden only with its original owner once. P/I overlap and X_in/X_out deduplicate other same-direction flow terms only; full new influx and full wet closing stocks coexist. A mixed-outlet origin does not create a second external row/quantity/provider.

normalized_exchange = A / D exactly once after raw conversion and justified reconciliation/allocation. For manufacturing choose A=A_j and D=Q; for original-cohort service/treatment choose A=A_cj and D=Qc; for a physical gross disclosure choose A=full V and D=its declared original first-release Q or Qc. Those are separate non-additive dimensions. When D is zero or unknown retain real raw quantities and loads and issue no unit result. Save the result with dimension/cohort identity; cards and protocol aggregation retrieve that same result without another division.

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Physical terminal, child purpose, direct pedal route, component version, material/form/state and native constraints must agree; keep ordinary missing identities visible.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Primary full documents; actual BOM and drawings; exact native identity and unit checks

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Complete period includes failures, zero output, start/stop, idle, cleanup, samples, actual unapproved/failed work and waste/treatment; no missing measured value becomes zero.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Time logs; meters; disposition; bills and supplier coverage

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Preserve every inherited exchange vector and vintage with disjoint raw/WIP/non-WIP/FG/repair/packaging/assets; document one numerator and one denominator for each non-additive dimension.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Physical reconciliation; original receipts; cohort and H; vector audit

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Retain actual uncertainty, ordinary auxiliary/provider/quantity gaps, missing native localization and unsupported core claims honestly; publication or science/translation approval is not inferred.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Gap register; source applicability; measured uncertainty and acceptance evidence

measurementRules.rule: 参考为1 kg首次整件放行玩具净质量；cp_release使用适当经校准秤、真实皮重、纳入件清单及验收记录称量各实际配置，实测验收净重加总为Q，不设件至kg系数。
保留各真实行分子单位：质量kg、电能MJ、货运t*km。仅真实速率积分，先凭独立测量换算原单位及物理状态；已积分总体积不再乘时长，不将Mass/kg强加全部行。
采集仅记未归一原始数据。第8节唯一single_quotient操作前先确定分子及真实批次分母；卡片与协议汇总取同一已保存normalized_exchange，均不再除。分母为零或缺失时保留真实负荷及库存，不出单位结果。

calculationRules.rule: 分配前将原始总量换为其真实原生广延单位。真实速率按实测区间积分一次，已积分量保持；体积至质量须独立实测该物质密度及状态。电能kWh至MJ精确因子3.6；货运采用实际实物毛载荷及距离和声明空返约定。

逐交换j：U_j = U_direct_j + B_open_store_j + R_store_j - B_close_store_j。U_direct为不入库存而直接消耗的支出或已净消耗记录；R_store仅为进入互斥未用或未归属非在制品库存的收料。同一收料或向量不能同时进入U_direct和R_store。仅对该库存分区修正一次，排除WIP、FG、包装及另已归属的资产服务；已净消耗记录不再修正。A_j = 期初WIP向量_j + U_j - 期末WIP向量_j - 正当T_other_j。T_other仅真其他批次或功能且正当移交一次时存在，不因普通废物或废料出售而有；扣减中不含期末FG。实物毛收料仍在独立核对视图保持完整。

calculationRules.applies_to: original-cohort service and asset burden dimensions
calculationRules.rule: 按原批次c及窗口H和原Qc确定真实已执行服务及有证据资产使用负荷。保留历史向量及真实原发运的D_rev，不假当前退货等重；真实增量替换、修理、测试及处理负荷只加一次，仅结转有证据未用或未归属服务及储量，不因已执行服务附在期末FG而扣除。
分子V为实际广延单位的真实完整实物事件方向；V不受经济份额、负荷分配或库存向量扣减缩量，其独立上游或服务负荷仅归原所有者一次。P与I重叠及X_in/X_out只对另一同方向流项去重，完整新增入流和完整湿期末库存并存。混合出口来源不再产生第二外部行、数量或供方。
原单位换算及正当核对分配后normalized_exchange = A / D，恰一次。制造选A=A_j及D=Q；原批次服务或处理选A=A_cj及D=Qc；实物毛披露选A=完整V及D=其声明的原首次放行Q或Qc；这些为互不叠加的独立维度。D为零或未知时保留真实原量及负荷，不出单位结果；连同维度及批次身份保存结果，卡片和协议汇总均取此同一结果，不再除。

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 物理终端、儿童用途、脚踏直驱路线、组件版本、材质或形态及状态与原生限制一致，普通身份缺口显式保留。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 完整原件; 真实BOM及图纸; 精确原生身份及单位核对

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 完整时期含失败、零产出、启停、闲置、清理、样品、真实未获准或失败作业及废物处理，缺实测值不填零。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 时间日志; 仪表; 处置; 账单及供方覆盖

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 互斥原料、WIP、非WIP、FG、维修、包装及资产逐交换保留向量和批代，每不叠加维度有一分子和一分母。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 实物核对; 原收据; 批次及H; 向量审计

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 如实保留不确定性、普通辅流或供方或数量缺口、原生本地化缺失及未支持核心主张，不推定发布或科学与翻译审定。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 缺口登记; 来源适用性; 实测不确定度及验收证据
